title: JHiMA-WebRL: A Joint Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
title_zh: JHiMA-WebRL：面向长程网页任务的联合分层多智能体强化学习框架

paragraphs.en: Multimodal web agents have shown promising capabilities for interacting with websites through graphical user interfaces (GUIs), yet realistic web tasks often require long-horizon, multi-step planning that remains challenging for monolithic policies. Such agents must jointly infer high-level plans, navigate through intermediate states, track progress over extended interaction histories, and execute visually grounded actions. Although prior work has explored modular multi-agent systems with a separate planner, the planner is typically not updated jointly with the actor. We investigate whether explicitly separating and jointly training planning and execution provides a stronger inductive bias for long-horizon web navigation. We introduce JHiMA-WebRL, a joint hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for web agents that couples a task decomposer with an actor. To train the decomposer, we use a strong teacher model to construct structured subtask supervision from multimodal GUI trajectories, and use these annotations to fine-tune both the decomposer and the subtask-conditioned actor. We then extend Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to jointly optimize the decomposer and actor in the interactive WebArena environment through hierarchical rollout grouping and role-specific advantages. On WebArena-Lite-v2, JHiMA-WebRL-14B, consisting of a 7B actor and a 7B decomposer, achieves an average success rate of 37.2%, compared with 24.0% for a ScaleCUA-32B agent that we fine-tune with RL on the same training tasks and evaluate under the same protocol. Ablations show that jointly updating the decomposer during RL outperforms updating the actor alone. These results suggest that jointly learned role factorization with smaller models can be a competitive alternative to scaling monolithic agents for long-horizon web tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态网络智能体已展现出通过图形用户界面（GUI）与网站交互的强大潜力，然而真实的网页任务往往需要长时程、多步骤的规划，这对单体策略而言仍然充满挑战。 这类智能体必须同时推断高层计划、在中间状态间导航、在漫长的交互历史中跟踪进度，并执行基于视觉的动作。 尽管已有工作探索了配备独立规划器的模块化多智能体系统，但规划器通常不会与执行器进行联合更新。 我们研究将规划与执行显式分离并进行联合训练，是否能为长时程网页导航提供更强的归纳偏置。 我们提出 JHiMA-WebRL，这是一个面向网络智能体的联合分层多智能体强化学习框架，将任务分解器与执行器耦合在一起。 为训练分解器，我们使用一个强大的教师模型从多模态 GUI 轨迹中构建结构化的子任务监督，并利用这些标注对分解器和以子任务为条件的执行器进行微调。 随后，我们扩展了组相对策略优化（GRPO），通过分层轨迹分组和角色专属优势，在交互式的 WebArena 环境中联合优化分解器与执行器。 在 WebArena-Lite-v2 上，由 7B 执行器和 7B 分解器组成的 JHiMA-WebRL-14B 取得了 37.2% 的平均成功率，而我们在相同训练任务上用强化学习微调并按相同协议评测的 ScaleCUA-32B 智能体仅为 24.0%。 消融实验表明，在强化学习过程中联合更新分解器优于仅更新执行器。 这些结果表明，通过较小模型联合学习角色分解，可以成为在长时程网页任务中替代扩展单体智能体的一种有竞争力的方案。

paragraphs.en: Multimodal web agents interact with websites by perceiving screenshots, interpreting page elements, and executing actions such as clicking, typing, scrolling, and navigating between webpages. Such agents could support workflows in online shopping, web-based administration, repository management, and information retrieval. Benchmarks such as WebArena ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) and VisualWebArena ( Koh et al., 2024 ) evaluate this setting through tasks that require interactive execution across multiple steps. These tasks combine high-level planning with low-level visually grounded control: for example, to cancel an order, an agent must navigate intermediate pages, identify relevant interface elements, track progress over a long action history, and avoid repeated or irrelevant actions.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态网络智能体通过感知截图、理解页面元素并执行点击、输入、滚动和网页间导航等操作来与网站交互。 这类智能体可以支持在线购物、基于网络的管理、代码仓库管理和信息检索等工作流程。 诸如 WebArena（Zhou et al., 2024）和 VisualWebArena（Koh et al., 2024）等基准通过需要跨多个步骤交互执行的任务来评估这一设定。 这些任务将高层规划与低层的视觉落地控制相结合：例如，要取消一个订单，智能体必须浏览中间页面、识别相关的界面元素、在漫长的动作历史中跟踪进度，并避免重复或无关的操作。

paragraphs.en: Many web agents use a monolithic policy that maps the task, observation, and action history directly to the next action, learning planning, state tracking, visual grounding, and execution within a single model. ScaleCUA ( Liu et al., 2025b ) and UI-TARS ( Qin et al., 2025 ) demonstrate the value of large-scale GUI data for training such policies, while WebAgent-R1 ( Wei et al., 2025 ) and WebRL ( Qi et al., 2025 ) improve web interaction through online reinforcement learning (RL). Modular systems instead introduce a separate planner: Agent S uses a manager to generate subtasks from retrieved knowledge and experience for workers to execute ( Agashe et al., 2025a ) , and Agent S2 adds proactive replanning as execution provides new observations ( Agashe et al., 2025b ) . Even though an explicit planner module can support long-horizon behavior, the planner’s parameters are not updated from the outcomes of action execution. Recent studies ( Erdogan et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Kong et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) focus on training modular agents for long-horizon tasks, but either train the modules separately, apply supervised learning or RL to only one module while freezing the other, or alternate updates between modules. To our knowledge, prior work has not studied simultaneous RL training of a separately parameterized planner and actor from a shared rollout batch in web environments.

paragraphs.en: We therefore introduce JHiMA-WebRL, a joint hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for long-horizon web interaction. Figure 1 presents an overview of the three stages in our framework: decomposer data generation, supervised fine-tuning, and joint hierarchical multi-agent RL. First, a strong teacher model converts multimodal GUI trajectories into ordered subtasks, supplying planning annotations that existing GUI trajectory datasets typically lack. Second, these annotations support supervised fine-tuning of two Qwen2.5-VL-7B models: a decomposer that predicts subtasks from the instruction and starting screenshot, and an actor that predicts the next GUI action conditioned on those subtasks. Finally, we jointly train both modules using terminal task success rewards while interacting with web environments, so that the decomposer can adapt its plans to the actor’s capabilities while the actor adapts to executing them. We extend Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) through the hierarchical rollout structure: the decomposer proposes K K candidate decompositions, and the actor performs M M complete environment rollouts for each decomposition. Actor-level advantages compare executions under the same plan, while decomposer-level advantages compare plans by the average terminal reward of their executions, and both policies are updated from this shared batch without dense process rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们提出了 JHiMA-WebRL，一个面向长程网页交互的联合分层多智能体强化学习框架。 图 1 概述了我们框架的三个阶段：分解器数据生成、监督微调以及联合分层多智能体强化学习。 首先，一个强大的教师模型将多模态 GUI 轨迹转换为有序的子任务，提供现有 GUI 轨迹数据集通常缺乏的规划标注。 其次，这些标注支持对两个 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 模型进行监督微调：一个是根据指令和起始截图预测子任务的分解器，另一个是以这些子任务为条件预测下一个 GUI 动作的智能体执行器。 最后，我们在与网页环境交互的过程中，使用终端任务成功奖励对这两个模块进行联合训练，使分解器能够根据执行器的能力调整其规划，同时执行器也适应于执行这些规划。 我们通过分层 rollout 结构扩展了组相对策略优化（GRPO）：分解器提出 K K 个候选分解方案，执行器对每个分解方案执行 M M 次完整的环境 rollout。 执行器层面的优势比较同一规划下的不同执行，而分解器层面的优势则通过各方案执行的平均终端奖励来比较不同规划，两个策略都从这个共享批次中更新，而无需密集的过程奖励。

paragraphs.en: A broad line of work studies modular or multi-agent LLM systems, including AutoGen, CAMEL, ChatDev, MetaGPT, and MAP ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Webb et al., 2025 ) . These mechanisms concern the organization and adaptation of inference-time behavior. Related methods such as ReAct, Reflexion, MiRA, SEAgent, and TreeCUA explore intermediate reasoning, subgoals, feedback, or structured exploration ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: A complementary line of work studies training across planner–executor interfaces. Plan-and-Act separately fine-tunes planner and executor models using synthetic plans and action trajectories, and adds dynamic replanning at inference time ( Erdogan et al., 2025 ) . Our approach also uses trajectory-derived planning supervision, then jointly adapts both modules through RL. Navigating WebAI pairs a supervised hierarchical planner with an RL-trained controller ( Thil et al., 2024 ) . Planner Matters! optimizes only the planner using trajectory rewards from a VLM judge, freezing the actor and memory manager ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . Its joint-training ablation shares parameters across roles, whereas our decomposer and actor are separate policies. In robotic manipulation, HiRoC aligns an executor with subgoals through supervised fine-tuning, then applies hierarchical GRPO to the executor with a frozen planner, combining task-level and subgoal-level advantages ( Kong et al., 2026 ) . SWIRL instead trains both modules through alternating RL phases ( Lu et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, JHiMA-WebRL computes actor advantages within plans and decomposer advantages across plans, and updates both policies from a shared rollout batch.
paragraphs.zh: 一条互补的研究路线探讨了跨规划器–执行器接口的训练。 Plan-and-Act 使用合成的规划与动作轨迹分别微调规划器模型和执行器模型，并在推理时加入动态重规划（Erdogan et al., 2025）。 我们的方法同样使用由轨迹导出的规划监督，然后通过强化学习联合适配两个模块。 Navigating WebAI 将监督式分层规划器与经强化学习训练的控制器相配对（Thil et al., 2024）。 Planner Matters! 仅使用来自视觉语言模型评判器的轨迹奖励来优化规划器，并冻结智能体与记忆管理器（Wu et al., 2026）。 其联合训练消融实验在角色间共享参数，而我们的分解器与智能体则是相互独立的策略。 在机器人操作领域，HiRoC 先通过监督微调使执行器与子目标对齐，随后在冻结规划器的条件下对执行器应用分层 GRPO，结合任务级与子目标级的优势（Kong et al., 2026）。 SWIRL 则通过交替的强化学习阶段同时训练两个模块（Lu et al., 2025）。 相比之下，JHiMA-WebRL 在规划内部计算智能体的优势、跨规划计算分解器的优势，并从共享的同一批 rollout 中更新两个策略。

paragraphs.en: PPO and GRPO provide the basic optimization tools for recent LLM and agent RL, while multi-agent RL methods such as MADDPG, COMA, QMIX, and MAPPO study credit assignment across interacting policies ( Schulman et al., 2017 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Lowe et al., 2017 ; Foerster et al., 2018 ; Rashid et al., 2018 ; Yu et al., 2022 ) . For web and GUI agents, WebAgent-R1, WebRL, OpenWebRL, and OpAgent apply online multi-turn RL to browser-based tasks, optimizing a single agent policy from terminal or outcome-based rewards ( Wei et al., 2025 ; Qi et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Guo et al., 2026 ) , while WorkForceAgent-R1 applies rule-based RL to single-step web decisions ( Zhuang et al., 2025 ) . Other works improve credit assignment with process or progress signals, including Web-Shepherd, WebArbiter, TGPO, GraphGPO, and MiRA ( Chae et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . We instead extend GRPO’s rollout grouping and advantage computation to two jointly trained roles, using only terminal rewards and no dense process rewards.

paragraphs.en: We propose JHiMA-WebRL, a joint hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for long-horizon web navigation. Our approach factorizes interaction into two specialized but jointly optimized modules: a task decomposer and an actor. The decomposer maps the task instruction and initial screenshot into an ordered sequence of executable subtasks. The actor then conditions on the task, current observation, interaction history, and generated subtasks to produce visually grounded actions in the web interface. Below, we first describe the problem formulation, followed by the three stages of our framework: data generation for training the decomposer, supervised fine-tuning of both the decomposer and actor, and a joint hierarchical multi-agent extension of GRPO.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 JHiMA-WebRL，这是一个用于长时程网页导航的联合分层多智能体强化学习框架。 我们的方法将交互分解为两个专门化但联合优化的模块：任务分解器和执行器。 分解器将任务指令和初始截图映射为一组有序的可执行子任务序列。 随后，执行器以任务、当前观测、交互历史以及生成的子任务为条件，在网页界面中生成有视觉依据的动作。 下面，我们首先描述问题形式化，然后介绍我们框架的三个阶段：用于训练分解器的数据生成、分解器与执行器的监督微调，以及 GRPO 的联合分层多智能体扩展。

paragraphs.en: We consider an interactive web environment modeled as a partially observed sequential decision problem. Each task is specified by a natural-language instruction x x . At time step t t , the agent receives a screenshot o t o_{t} of the web interface and produces an action a t ∈ 𝒜 a_{t}\in\mathcal{A} , such as clicking a page element, typing, scrolling, navigating between webpages, or terminating with an answer. The environment then transitions to a new state and returns the next observation o t + 1 o_{t+1} . A trajectory is denoted by τ = ( o 0 , a 0 , o 1 , a 1 , … , o T ) \tau=(o_{0},a_{0},o_{1},a_{1},\ldots,o_{T}) , where T T is the trajectory length. Each trajectory receives a terminal task reward R ⁡ ( τ ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } R(\tau)\in\{0,1\} , where R ⁡ ( τ ) = 1 R(\tau)=1 if the task is successfully completed and R ⁡ ( τ ) = 0 R(\tau)=0 otherwise. Success is determined through environment-specific rule-based verification or an LLM judge.

paragraphs.en: After supervised fine-tuning, the joint RL stage of JHiMA-WebRL optimizes the decomposer and actor using GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , extended to their hierarchical interaction. We retain the GRPO clipped policy objectives and compute role-specific advantages from hierarchical rollout groups to assign credit to planning and execution. Standard web-agent RL methods often optimize a single policy from terminal trajectory rewards ( Wei et al., 2025 ; Qi et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) . In contrast, our setting contains two interacting policies with different roles and action spaces: the decomposer generates a high-level plan, and the actor executes low-level web-interface actions conditioned on that plan.
paragraphs.zh: 在监督微调之后，JHiMA-WebRL 的联合强化学习阶段使用 GRPO（Shao et al., 2024）对分解器和执行器进行优化，并将其扩展到二者的层级交互。 我们保留了 GRPO 的截断策略目标，并从层级 rollout 组中计算特定角色的优势，以便为规划与执行分配信用。 标准的网页智能体强化学习方法通常基于终止轨迹奖励来优化单一策略（Wei et al., 2025; Qi et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2026a）。 相比之下，我们的设定包含两个具有不同角色和动作空间且相互作用的策略：分解器生成高层计划，而执行器在该计划的条件下执行低层网页界面动作。

paragraphs.en: Both modules were then jointly trained through online reinforcement learning using the training tasks associated with WebArena-Lite, following the setup of WebAgent-R1 ( Wei et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: We compared against native agents at several model scales ranging from 7B to 72B, allowing comparisons between our 14B modular system and both smaller and larger monolithic systems. We also compared against multi-agent systems consisting of a proprietary planner (GPT-4o) with a grounding module. These provide comparisons with systems that separate planning from visual grounding, but do not jointly train a learned decomposer and actor as in JHiMA-WebRL-14B. The UI-TARS and GPT-4o planner–grounder results are taken from ScaleCUA ( Liu et al., 2025b ) (15-step budget). The ScaleCUA-7B/32B SFT and GUI-Libra-8B results are taken from the re-evaluation of Yang et al. (2026b) , which uses a 15-step budget, averages four runs, and replaces the GPT-4o fuzzy-match judge with GPT-5. Under its original evaluation setup, ScaleCUA reports higher scores for its own models (37.7% for ScaleCUA-7B and 44.2% for ScaleCUA-32B at 15 steps). We also trained a ScaleCUA-32B RL baseline, specifically fine-tuning the SFT model on the WebArena training set, using standard multi-turn GRPO with 7 rollouts and a maximum of 15 interaction steps. For a fair comparison with our method, we only included baselines that do not use HTML or DOM information.

paragraphs.en: We trained the 7B decomposer and 7B actor of JHiMA-WebRL-14B in two stages: SFT, followed by joint hierarchical RL. The decomposer was initialized from Qwen2.5-VL-7B and fine-tuned on the approximately 76 76 K decomposition examples generated from ScaleCUA multimodal trajectories, on 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs with 80 GB of memory each via full-parameter fine-tuning. We trained for 1 epoch with a learning rate of 1e-5 and a cosine learning-rate schedule with a warmup ratio of 0.03 . The per-device batch size was 2 , with gradient accumulation over 4 steps, resulting in an effective global batch size of 64 . We used DeepSpeed ( Rajbhandari et al., 2020 ) for distributed training with ZeRO-3, along with gradient checkpointing, bf16 mixed-precision training, gradient clipping to a maximum norm of 1 , and a maximum token length of 30720 . The actor was also initialized from Qwen2.5-VL-7B and fine-tuned with the same hyperparameters as above, using released ScaleCUA trajectories augmented with generated subtasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分两个阶段训练了 JHiMA-WebRL-14B 的 7B 分解器和 7B 智能体：先进行 SFT，随后进行联合分层强化学习。 分解器以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 初始化，并在由 ScaleCUA 多模态轨迹生成的约 76 76 K 条分解样本上，使用 8 块各 80 GB 显存的 NVIDIA H100 GPU 进行全参数微调。 我们训练了 1 个 epoch，学习率为 1e-5，采用预热比例为 0.03 的余弦学习率调度。 每个设备的批大小为 2，梯度累积 4 步，因此有效全局批大小为 64。 我们使用 DeepSpeed（Rajbhandari et al., 2020）配合 ZeRO-3 进行分布式训练，同时采用梯度检查点、bf16 混合精度训练、最大范数为 1 的梯度裁剪以及 30720 的最大 token 长度。 智能体同样以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 初始化，并使用与上述相同的超参数进行微调，所用数据为由生成的子任务增广的 ScaleCUA 已发布轨迹。

sents.zh: 分解器以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 初始化，并在由 ScaleCUA 多模态轨迹生成的约 76 76 K 条分解样本上，使用 8 块各 80 GB 显存的 NVIDIA H100 GPU 进行全参数微调。

sents.en: We trained for 1 epoch with a learning rate of 1e-5 and a cosine learning-rate schedule with a warmup ratio of 0.03 .
sents.zh: 我们训练了 1 个 epoch，学习率为 1e-5，采用预热比例为 0.03 的余弦学习率调度。

sents.en: The per-device batch size was 2 , with gradient accumulation over 4 steps, resulting in an effective global batch size of 64 .
sents.zh: 每个设备的批大小为 2，梯度累积 4 步，因此有效全局批大小为 64。

sents.en: We used DeepSpeed ( Rajbhandari et al., 2020 ) for distributed training with ZeRO-3, along with gradient checkpointing, bf16 mixed-precision training, gradient clipping to a maximum norm of 1 , and a maximum token length of 30720 .
sents.zh: 我们使用 DeepSpeed（Rajbhandari et al., 2020）配合 ZeRO-3 进行分布式训练，同时采用梯度检查点、bf16 混合精度训练、最大范数为 1 的梯度裁剪以及 30720 的最大 token 长度。

sents.en: The actor was also initialized from Qwen2.5-VL-7B and fine-tuned with the same hyperparameters as above, using released ScaleCUA trajectories augmented with generated subtasks.
sents.zh: 智能体同样以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 初始化，并使用与上述相同的超参数进行微调，所用数据为由生成的子任务增广的 ScaleCUA 已发布轨迹。

paragraphs.en: After SFT, both the actor and decomposer were jointly optimized through LoRA fine-tuning using GRPO, with standard-deviation and response-length normalization removed to reduce optimization bias, following Liu et al. (2025c) . We used LoRA rank r = 32 r=\texttt{32} and scaling factor α = 64 \alpha=\texttt{64} for both modules, with a separate adapter for each. For each task, the decomposer sampled K = 3 K=\texttt{3} candidate decompositions. For every decomposition, the actor generated M = 7 M=\texttt{7} complete trajectories. For both, we used 0.8 as the sampling temperature, and we allowed a maximum of 15 interaction steps per trajectory. We optimized the LoRA parameters with a learning rate of 1e-5 . The GRPO updates used clipping parameters ϵ A = ϵ D = 0.2 \epsilon_{A}=\epsilon_{D}=\texttt{0.2} , KL coefficients β A = β D = 0 \beta_{A}=\beta_{D}=\texttt{0} (i.e., no KL penalty), and 2 optimization steps per rollout batch. We used 32 gradient accumulation steps and trained for 1 epoch over the 647 647 training tasks. We used the efficient parallel trajectory rollout generation of M-GRPO ( Wei et al., 2025 ) for each task decomposition, with training taking approximately 720 GPU-hours on a cluster of 8 H100 GPUs with 80 GB of memory each.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 1 , JHiMA-WebRL-14B achieved the highest average success rate among the listed methods, 37.2% over four runs, and the highest scores on GitLab (47.5%), Reddit (60.5%), Shopping (29.0%), and ShoppingAdmin (44.3%). The most controlled comparison is with ScaleCUA-32B RL, which we trained on the same RL tasks with the same step budget and evaluated under the same protocol: JHiMA-WebRL-14B outperformed it by 13.2 percentage points with fewer total parameters. Among results from prior work, JHiMA-WebRL-14B exceeded the GPT-4o + ScaleCUA-7B planner–grounder system (28.6%), GUI-Libra-8B (26.6%), and UI-TARS-72B-DPO (23.4%); however, these numbers come from evaluation setups that differ from ours, and ScaleCUA reports 44.2% for ScaleCUA-32B under its original setup (Section 4.2 ). The Map domain is the exception: JHiMA-WebRL-14B (12.5%) trails GUI-Libra-8B (17.3%) and ScaleCUA-7B SFT (15.4%). Figure 6 shows an example Map failure in which the agent repeatedly toggles the zoom controls until the 15-step budget is exhausted. Within our controlled comparisons, these results suggest that learned role factorization with smaller, jointly trained models is a competitive alternative to scaling a monolithic agent.

paragraphs.en: We analyzed the contribution of the components of JHiMA-WebRL-14B through ablations (Table 2 ). First, we trained only the actor with RL while keeping the SFT decomposer frozen (‘w/o decomposer RL’), using the same number of rollouts per task ( K = 3 K{=}3 , M = 7 M{=}7 ) as JHiMA-WebRL-14B. This reduced the average success rate to 33.4%, a drop of 3.8 percentage points, indicating that updating the decomposer jointly with the actor matters. Second, to assess the role of the decomposer, we trained the actor alone using standard multi-turn GRPO without subtask conditioning. The actor was initialized from Qwen2.5-VL-7B and fine-tuned using supervised learning on released ScaleCUA trajectories and grounding data, without any subtasks. We trained two variants: one with the same total number of rollouts per task as JHiMA-WebRL-14B (21), and one with 7 rollouts, matching the per-decomposition group size of our actor. The two variants reached 34.9% and 35.2%, i.e., 2.3 and 2.0 percentage points below JHiMA-WebRL-14B. Finally, we removed RL entirely and evaluated the SFT decomposer and SFT actor together (‘w/o RL’), which reduced the average success rate by 2.1 percentage points. Notably, actor-only RL with a frozen SFT decomposer (33.4%) scored below this SFT-only system (35.1%), whereas joint RL improved on it; the SFT-only modular system also performed on par with the decomposer-free actors trained with RL (34.9% and 35.2%).
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过消融实验（表 2）分析了 JHiMA-WebRL-14B 各组件的贡献。 首先，我们在冻结 SFT 分解器的情况下，仅用强化学习训练执行器（"w/o decomposer RL"），并使用与 JHiMA-WebRL-14B 相同的每任务采样次数（K=3、M=7）。 这使平均成功率降至 33.4%，下降了 3.8 个百分点，表明将分解器与执行器联合更新非常重要。 其次，为评估分解器的作用，我们使用不带子任务条件的标准多轮 GRPO 单独训练执行器。 该执行器以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 初始化，并在已发布的 ScaleCUA 轨迹和定位数据上通过监督学习进行微调，未使用任何子任务。 我们训练了两个变体：一个使用与 JHiMA-WebRL-14B 相同的每任务总采样次数（21），另一个使用 7 次采样，与我们执行器的每次分解组规模一致。 这两个变体分别达到 34.9% 和 35.2%，即分别比 JHiMA-WebRL-14B 低 2.3 和 2.0 个百分点。 最后，我们完全去除了强化学习，将 SFT 分解器和 SFT 执行器一起评估（"w/o RL"），这使平均成功率下降了 2.1 个百分点。 值得注意的是，使用冻结 SFT 分解器的仅执行器强化学习（33.4%）得分低于这一仅 SFT 系统（35.1%），而联合强化学习则优于它；仅 SFT 的模块化系统的表现也与使用强化学习训练的无分解器执行器（34.9% 和 35.2%）相当。

paragraphs.en: For each WebArena-Lite-v2 trajectory from the four evaluation runs, we used GPT-5.2-Codex to judge whether each subgoal generated by the decomposer was completed, based on the sequence of predicted actions and resulting screenshots, and computed the fraction of generated subgoals that were completed. We first evaluated whether the fraction of completed subgoals discriminated successful trajectories from failed ones. We treated the fraction as a continuous prediction score for the binary task outcome and computed the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). As shown in Figure 2(a) , the subgoals generated by JHiMA-WebRL-14B achieved an AUROC of 0.838, well above chance (0.5) and comparable to the SFT-only system (‘w/o RL’, 0.836). Progress through the generated decompositions is therefore predictive of downstream task success, both before and after joint RL.
paragraphs.zh: 对于四次评估运行中的每条 WebArena-Lite-v2 轨迹，我们使用 GPT-5.2-Codex 基于预测动作序列及由此产生的截图来判断分解器生成的每个子目标是否完成，并计算已完成的生成子目标所占的比例。 我们首先评估了已完成子目标的比例能否区分成功轨迹与失败轨迹。 我们将该比例视为针对二元任务结果的连续预测分数，并计算了受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）。 如图 2(a) 所示，JHiMA-WebRL-14B 生成的子目标取得了 0.838 的 AUROC，远高于随机水平（0.5），并与仅使用 SFT 的系统（“w/o RL”，0.836）相当。 因此，无论在联合 RL 之前还是之后，生成分解中的进展程度都能预测下游任务的成功。

sents.en: We treated the fraction as a continuous prediction score for the binary task outcome and computed the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC).
sents.zh: 我们将该比例视为针对二元任务结果的连续预测分数，并计算了受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 2(a) , the subgoals generated by JHiMA-WebRL-14B achieved an AUROC of 0.838, well above chance (0.5) and comparable to the SFT-only system (‘w/o RL’, 0.836).
sents.zh: 如图 2(a) 所示，JHiMA-WebRL-14B 生成的子目标取得了 0.838 的 AUROC，远高于随机水平（0.5），并与仅使用 SFT 的系统（“w/o RL”，0.836）相当。

sents.en: Progress through the generated decompositions is therefore predictive of downstream task success, both before and after joint RL.
sents.zh: 因此，无论在联合 RL 之前还是之后，生成分解中的进展程度都能预测下游任务的成功。

paragraphs.en: A useful decomposition should also provide a monotone notion of progress, so we grouped trajectories by subgoal completion fraction and computed the empirical success rate per group. For JHiMA-WebRL-14B, empirical task success increases monotonically with subgoal completion fraction (Figure 2(b) ), with Kendall’s rank correlation coefficient τ = 0.516 \tau=0.516 , compared with τ = 0.503 \tau=0.503 without RL. Together with the AUROC analysis, these results suggest that the generated subgoals act as intermediate milestones associated with downstream task completion.

paragraphs.en: Our study has several limitations. (i) Train–test overlap: RL is performed on the remaining WebArena tasks, which are disjoint from the evaluation tasks but can share intent templates and websites with them; results thus reflect in-environment generalization, not transfer to unseen websites. (ii) Supervision and cost: decomposition supervision is generated by a proprietary teacher (GPT-5.2-Codex) without human verification of annotation quality, and hierarchical rollouts require K × M K{\times}M complete episodes per task, which is costly in live environments. (iii) Open-loop planning: the decomposer plans once from the initial observation and cannot revise the plan during execution. (iv) Coarse credit: terminal rewards assign the same advantage to every token of a decomposition or trajectory, without identifying which subtask or action caused success or failure. (v) Evaluation scope: we evaluate on a single benchmark of 154 tasks, and the ablation differences (2.0–3.8 percentage points) are of a size where run-to-run variance matters.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究存在若干局限性。 (i) 训练–测试重叠：强化学习在剩余的 WebArena 任务上进行，这些任务与评测任务不相交，但可能与它们共享意图模板和网站；因此结果反映的是环境内泛化，而非向未见网站的迁移。 (ii) 监督与成本：分解监督由专有教师模型（GPT-5.2-Codex）生成，未对标注质量进行人工校验，且分层 rollout 在每个任务上需要 K × M K{\times}M 次完整回合，在真实环境中成本高昂。 (iii) 开环规划：分解器仅基于初始观测进行一次规划，无法在执行过程中修正计划。 (iv) 粗粒度信用分配：终止奖励为某个分解或轨迹的每个 token 分配相同的优势值，而无法识别是哪个子任务或动作导致了成功或失败。 (v) 评测范围：我们在仅包含 154 个任务的单一基准上进行评测，且消融实验的差异（2.0–3.8 个百分点）处于运行间方差会造成影响的量级。

paragraphs.en: We introduced JHiMA-WebRL, a framework for jointly training a task decomposer and a visually grounded actor. The framework generates subtask supervision from multimodal GUI trajectories to train the decomposer and extends GRPO with hierarchical rollout grouping and role-specific advantages. JHiMA-WebRL-14B achieved an average success rate of 37.2% on WebArena-Lite-v2, 13.2 percentage points above a ScaleCUA-32B RL baseline trained and evaluated under the same protocol. In ablations, removing decomposer updates during RL, removing the decomposer together with subtask conditioning, or removing RL each lowered the average success rate, by 2.0–3.8 percentage points.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 JHiMA-WebRL，这是一个联合训练任务分解器与视觉定位执行器的框架。 该框架从多模态 GUI 轨迹中生成子任务监督来训练分解器，并通过层级式 rollout 分组和角色特定的优势函数扩展了 GRPO。 JHiMA-WebRL-14B 在 WebArena-Lite-v2 上取得了 37.2% 的平均成功率，比在相同协议下训练和评估的 ScaleCUA-32B 强化学习基线高出 13.2 个百分点。 在消融实验中，去掉强化学习期间分解器的更新、将分解器连同子任务条件一起移除、或去掉强化学习，均会降低平均成功率，降幅为 2.0–3.8 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Our work suggests several future directions. First, the decomposer could be made adaptive , revising subtasks as execution deviates from the plan. Second, joint optimization can be combined with intermediate progress signals such as milestone rewards ( Wang et al., 2026 ) or graph-based credit assignment ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . Finally, jointly trained decomposer–actor systems could be extended to cross-domain and live-web settings, where online RL has recently been shown to be feasible ( Yang et al., 2026a ) . This would test whether modular role factorization transfers better than monolithic policies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作提出了若干未来研究方向。 首先，可以将分解器设计为自适应的，在执行偏离计划时修订子任务。 其次，可以将联合优化与中间进度信号相结合，例如里程碑奖励（Wang et al., 2026）或基于图的信用分配（Cheng et al., 2026）。 最后，联合训练的分解器–智能体系统可以扩展到跨域和实时网络环境中，在线强化学习最近已被证明在这些环境中是可行的（Yang et al., 2026a）。 这将检验模块化的角色分解是否比单体策略具有更好的迁移能力。

sents.zh: 根据策略梯度定理，∇ θ D J = 𝔼 d ​ [ ∇ θ D ​ log ​ π θ D ​ ( d ∣ x , o 0 ) ​ ( Q ⁡ ( d ) − b ) ] \nabla_{\theta_{D}}J=\mathbb{E}_{d}\big[\nabla_{\theta_{D}}\log\pi_{\theta_{D}}(d\mid x,o_{0})\,(Q(d)-b)\big] ，其中 Q ⁡ ( d ) = 𝔼 τ ​ [ R ⁡ ( τ ) ∣ d ] Q(d)=\mathbb{E}_{\tau}[R(\tau)\mid d] ，且 b b 为任何不依赖于 d d 的基线。

sents.en: The score S i S_{i} in Eq. equation 8 is an unbiased Monte Carlo estimate of Q ⁡ ( d i ) Q(d_{i}) under the current actor; the M M inner rollouts reduce its variance relative to scoring a decomposition by a single rollout.
sents.zh: 式（公式 8）中的得分 S i S_{i} 是在当前智能体（actor）下对 Q ⁡ ( d i ) Q(d_{i}) 的无偏蒙特卡洛估计；相对于用单次 rollout 对分解进行打分，M M 次内部 rollout 降低了其方差。

sents.en: Because the group mean S ¯ \bar{S} includes S i S_{i} , we have S i − S ¯ = K − 1 K ​ ( S i − S ¯ − i ) S_{i}-\bar{S}=\frac{K-1}{K}\,(S_{i}-\bar{S}_{-i}) , where the leave-one-out mean S ¯ − i \bar{S}_{-i} depends only on the other K − 1 K-1 independently sampled decompositions and their rollouts, and is therefore a valid baseline for d i d_{i} .
sents.zh: 由于组均值 S ¯ \bar{S} 包含 S i S_{i} ，我们有 S i − S ¯ = K − 1 K ​ ( S i − S ¯ − i ) S_{i}-\bar{S}=\frac{K-1}{K}\,(S_{i}-\bar{S}_{-i}) ，其中留一均值 S ¯ − i \bar{S}_{-i} 仅依赖于其余 K − 1 K-1 个独立采样的分解及其 rollout，因此对于 d i d_{i} 而言是一个有效的基线。

sents.en: Hence, without standard-deviation normalization, the decomposer advantage gives an unbiased policy-gradient estimate up to the positive factor ( K − 1 ) / K (K-1)/K ; dividing by the group standard deviation, as in standard GRPO, rescales the estimate per task and no longer preserves this property exactly.
sents.zh: 因此，在不做标准差归一化的情况下，分解器优势给出的策略梯度估计在相差正因子 ( K − 1 ) / K (K-1)/K 的意义下是无偏的；而像标准 GRPO 那样除以组标准差，会按任务对估计进行重缩放，从而不再精确保持这一性质。

sents.en: Likewise, conditioning the actor baseline on d i d_{i} (Eq. equation 5 ) removes the reward variance attributable to plan quality from the actor’s advantage, so that actor updates compare executions of the same plan.
sents.zh: 同样地，让智能体的基线以 d i d_{i} 为条件（公式 5），可以从智能体的优势中去除可归因于计划质量的奖励方差，使得智能体的更新是对同一计划的不同执行之间的比较。

sents.en: Because both policies change simultaneously, each module’s learning problem is non-stationary; we rely on the PPO-style clipping and a small number of optimization steps per batch to keep per-iteration policy changes small.
sents.zh: 由于两个策略同时变化，每个模块的学习问题都是非平稳的；我们依靠 PPO 风格的裁剪以及每批次少量的优化步数，来使每次迭代中的策略变化保持较小。
